title: Microsoft Teams: MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI replace the Copilot meeting policy
notes: claim 66: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the page says Microsoft has not documented an administrator control for intelligent recap, but Learn documents a PowerShell control that disables it. It also labels the new controls' default state as unstated despite published parameter defaults and Microsoft's automatic migration notice.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to replace the Copilot meeting policy with MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI.
claims.quote: The existing Copilot meeting policy is being replaced by two more specific policies:

claims.claim: The default state of the new controls is unknown or not stated.
claims.quote: -MeetingAI: Default value: EnabledAllowOrganizerOverride; -TranscriptionWithMeetingAI: Default value: EnabledNoOverride
claims.fix: Replace unknown with on for the automatically introduced controls. Explain that existing effective behaviour is preserved by MC1532253's automatic mapping, not reset to a universal AI-on configuration; separately give Learn's parameter defaults and its not-fully-released caveat.

claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select an existing policy or create a new one.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot supports Enabled, EnabledWithTranscript, EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn and Disabled.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an administrator setting for the organiser-facing Intelligent Recap option.
claims.quote: To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false.
claims.fix: Replace the blanket absence claim with the documented Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false control and add its control row and source. Explain that it disables all intelligent recap, with or without saved transcripts, and makes related settings unavailable. Also report the disagreement: the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference still says AllowIntelligentRecap is not fully released and has no effect; do not silently choose between the pages.
